locationQuality: Strong — Located within the Algarve Golden Triangle between Quinta do Lago and Vale do Lobo, the country's highest-priced residential submarket; Faro Airport 20 minutes away; resort golf (Royal and Ocean, designed by Sir Henry Cotton), spa, and tennis within 3 km; A22 and EN125 access; established international buyer base with decades of transaction and price depth.
designQuality: Unknown — The credited architect (David Sinclair Arquitectos Associados) does not list The V in their accessible portfolio and the nature of their role (lead design, executive architect, or project management) has not been publicly specified; no published renders have been described in available sources; the architectural character and spatial coherence of the building cannot be independently assessed.
developerReputation: Weak — The development vehicle (Brand & Wheeler-Brand Lda, incorporated June 2023, declared capital €1–5,000) has no prior delivery history as a legal entity; the wider Wheeler & Brand group's confirmed completed portfolio consists of a single house; The V is the group's first multi-unit apartment scheme and no financial partner or lender has been disclosed.
specificationCredibility: Adequate — Named construction contractor (MAE Marques Antunes Engenharia, independently confirmed), named kitchen supplier (Edwin Loxley), and named interior partner (Pure Allure Interior, Flexform and Casamilano dealer for Portugal) provide specification specificity; however, pricing and delivery dates are absent from the developer's own website, sustainability language ('water conservation and native planting') carries no named certification, and no published material schedule exists.
propositionAuthenticity: Weak — A developer with no multi-unit apartment delivery history is pricing the entry unit at ~€10,815/sqm — close to Quinta do Lago benchmarks — with an unspecified architect role, marketing language ('Exceptional Living: a lifestyle beyond exclusivity, rooted in nature') that outpaces the independently verifiable substance, and no independent editorial press coverage.
recommendationLogic: No auto-disqualifier fired (no legal dispute, no documented delivery failure, construction has started per confirmed engineering contractor MAE, project is not generic high-volume). Three deferral triggers apply: (1) no previous deliveries evidenced for a developer making premium claims — Brand & Wheeler-Brand Lda was incorporated June 2023 with minimal capital and has no confirmed delivery history; (2) delivery date not establishable from primary sources — thev.pt publishes no completion date; (3) architect credit present but role unspecified and portfolio confirmation absent — designQuality is Unknown, which per criteria is treated as a deferral trigger. Recommendation: Insufficient information — defer pending architect role confirmation, construction progress evidence, and ideally disclosure of a financial partner.
